newsitem.title: USA: Poll finds Indiana governors race deadlocked.
newsitem.headline: Poll finds Indiana governors race deadlocked.

text.p: A poll published Thursday found the race for govenor of Indiana deadlocked, with a 1.2-point margin separating the two candidates.
The Indiana University poll showed Democrat Frank O'Bannon, the state's lieutenant governor, at 44.9 percent and the Republican mayor of Indianapolis, Stephen Goldsmith, at 43.7 percent.
The poll's margin of error was plus or minus 3.5 points and was based on a survey of 1,000 voters.
Goldsmith and O'Bannon are seeking the office now held by Democrat Evan Bayh who is prohibited by state law from seeking another term.
